title: [BUG] /bug command does not work
body:
Would be cool if /bug actually allowed you to file a bug with Claude Code.


```
> /bug

⏺ Fetch(https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/cli-usage)
  ⎿  Received 1.9MB (200 OK)

⏺ Fetch(https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/troubleshooting)
  ⎿  Received 2MB (200 OK)

⏺ To report a bug in Claude Code, use the /bug command to send a report directly to Anthropic. You can also check for
  known issues on GitHub at https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues.
```
